question: At the same four-dense-step warmed parameter point and identical per-policy gradients, does preserving actual attention save scopes pass actual next AdamW update fidelity with matched nonzero moments? Fresh-state clones are secondary controls only.

config.schedule_selection: dense warmup batches 0..3, fixed probe batch 4; no holdout
config.optimizer_group: all 76 trainable tensors in one group, including biases/norms
config.reference: independent float64 NumPy AdamW from each actual pre-step theta/gradient/m/v/t; input-scale moment bounds and propagated parameter interval

reference_bounds.parameter_interval: evaluate all 4 corners of m1 +/- m_tolerance and max(0,v1 +/- v_tolerance), include bias correction; enlarge by 8*eps32*(abs(theta0)+max(abs(corner_updates)))+8*tiny32

config.execution: CPU float32 eager, single thread deterministic; dense forward, CE outside save hooks; fixed parameter point after warmup

controls: Every native warmup and clone step has independent theta/m/v/step receipts; all 76 parameters require finite gradients
Each context has identical complete cloned theta/m/v/step across policies; each tensor including step storage is disjoint from source and siblings
Probe weights and warm optimizer state hashes are unchanged across all policies/contexts; original pretrained weights change only during the declared dense warmup
Exact CE analytic control, 13 norm and 6 actual attention scopes are checked; no policy/threshold/seed selection after outcomes
Primary requires all seeds matched_step4 joint gate; fresh_step0 cannot rescue primary
Reports retain raw worker metrics/hash chains and failed scientific gates; control failures/timeout mean incomplete, never a valid science failure
stop_conditions: Any numerical/state/hash/coverage/scope/control failure stops publication of a completed scientific result
360 second measured worker budget and 420 second parent wall cap including startup; nonzero exit/timeout retained as incomplete
Exactly one declared run; no threshold/policy/seed/batch retuning or additional state counts on these results
limitations: Three fixed synthetic schedules overlap; not independent statistical replicates or a sealed quality benchmark
Four dense warmup steps are only a short generated state trajectory, not general optimizer-history coverage
Fresh state at warmed weights is not a reproduction of the earlier pretrained first-step report
No compressed training trajectory, holdout evaluation, convergence, model quality, matched-time efficiency, peak-memory/GPU, AttnRes or operand-level causality claim
The reusable SaveScope v0.1 API remains fresh-state only; this is a separate original experimental probe, not an API compatibility promise
